notes.title: Cottonville – Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Cottonville residents! 🌼[/h2][p]
We have come to announce great news. [i]Cottonville [/i]has received a new patch![/p][p]What are the improvements? See the details below! 🌿[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/137e7d39ca7491ee1156a7824c2fc0c100d2f551.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][p]🌸 Mouse support – now you can enjoy the [i]Cottonville [/i]experience also with your mouse and not only a keyboard.[/p][p]🌸 In-game time shown correctly – we have fixed the issue regarding the in-game time being displayed inappropriately.[/p][p]🌸 Animation acceleration – animations and interactions concerning farming, like watering the plants, are now sped up.[/p][p]🌸UI interactions – are now faster, so you can create new outfits even quicker![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/ad569362f77a673a288a34f0883505184fa4de0c.png"][/img][/p][p]We highly appreciate your feedback and support. ❤️🤝 We are constantly monitoring our social media and community channels for your feedback and trying our hardest to make [i]Cottonville [/i]your best cozy gaming experience. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support without which the creation of [i]Cottonville [/i]would not have been possible. 🥰 We continue to do our best to meet all your expectations.[/p]

tags.feature: 🌸 Mouse support – now you can enjoy the [i]Cottonville [/i]experience also with your mouse and not only a keyboard.

tags.bug: 🌸 In-game time shown correctly – we have fixed the issue regarding the in-game time being displayed inappropriately.

tags.feature: 🌸 Animation acceleration – animations and interactions concerning farming, like watering the plants, are now sped up.
🌸UI interactions – are now faster, so you can create new outfits even quicker!

notes.title: Cottonville - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [h2]Cottonville citizens! 🌿[/h2][p][/p][p]Listening to your requests, we would like to announce to you some [b]important news[/b]! There have been some [b]streamlining changes in [i]Cottonville[/i][/b], and we are happy to bring you the details now! 💖🧵🍀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/1ffa7209cdfafdafac058885a11ccff0603414f3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Here are the improvements that have been added to [i]Cottonville[/i]:[/b][/p][p]🌸 Addition of controller support and Steam Deck support with appropriate UI,[/p][p]🌸 Added sprint option with now two speed versions available,[/p][p]🌸 Updated save menu notification (photos before and after).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Before:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/71035ad77e62e0529ec9a3d9c3feae20020df9da.png"][/img][/p][p][b]After:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/1a8ab45439ae7f0dd62b0cebcb7fefb522ae27e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are constantly monitoring our community and social media channels and take your feedback to heart. We hope to implement more features and continue working on [i]Cottonville[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/ab420e91a53758d49f6086f0ab35d98a542e2ee4.png"][/img]     [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm, without which the creation of [i]Cottonville[/i] would not have been possible. We will continue to do our best to meet all your expectations. [/p][h3][b]Your enjoyment of the game is our greatest reward [/b]🌱✂️🧶[/h3]

tags.feature: 🌸 Addition of controller support and Steam Deck support with appropriate UI,
🌸 Added sprint option with now two speed versions available,
🌸 Updated save menu notification (photos before and after).

notes.title: Cottonville's Kickstarter is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/d78dbcba6db9aee5ab9da2542f98610f629bafa4.png[/img]

[h2]Hello fashionable folks![/h2]

[h3]Cottonville's Kickstarter campaign will be live on the 1st of April![/h3]

For all of you who would like to help us with the growth of the game, you can follow the campaign now to be notified the moment it launches - the link is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/reddeergames/cottonville-a-cute-dress-up-farming-game]HERE[/url]

Supporting our Kickstarter helps bring this cozy chibi-anime-inspired world to life, unlocking more customization, deeper storytelling, and exciting features! 👀✨ 

Our stretch goals will expand gameplay mainly with new clothing collections, farm upgrades, special NPC interactions, seasonal events, and additional story-driven quests. With those, we aim to make Cottonville more lively and cozy than ever before!

Hope to see you there, thank you for reading 💞👋
